claim: G31 P6 R1: Berton's explicit selection of the sole previously observed human account can be bound mechanically to exactly one stable Mattermost principal in ignored private state and represented publicly by source-bound hashes that native PeTTa/MeTTa accepts as principal authority while independently retaining live-effect approval as unresolved.
non_claims: No new network request, credential lookup, post/content read, message effect, complete live grant, canary approval, VoiceRNA certification, adapter activation/promotion, server mutation, model call, general user-directory authority, or G31 closure.
rationale: P5 proved one human candidate exists in the exact allowlisted channel but correctly refused to infer authority. Berton has now explicitly selected that account. C-005-C-008/C-020/C-023/C-050/C-064-C-066/C-098 require the selection to remain distinct from capability, generation and live-effect approval. Binding the selection by its prior stable identity and source hash closes the identity ambiguity without laundering it into permission to send a message.
reading: Retain both controls and the complete G29-G31 lineage. Reread C-004-C-008, C-020-C-024, C-050-C-055, C-060-C-066, C-090-C-104; S-103/S-401-S-404/S-501-S-504/S-804/S-901-S-905/S-1004-S-1005/S-1101-S-1105/S-1201-S-1203; ACCEPTANCE G31; POC_SPEC 16; D-024-D-026; and W-120-W-127. Treat Berton's confirmation as identity-selection authority only because the prior instruction explicitly withheld message sending.
representation: A fixed Prolog mechanical binder reads the exact ignored P5 identity record, verifies its expected SHA-256 and candidate/transport hashes, finds exactly one candidate matching the human-supplied account name, and writes a new ignored mode-0600 authority-binding record without changing P5. It emits a public typed observation containing only identity hashes, source hash, uniqueness, authority label, and explicit unresolved live-effect approval. Native MeTTa validates the relations and produces a bound-awaiting-live-grant standing.
consumer: Prolog performs private JSON readback, exact matching, hashing, restrictive atomic storage and typed observation mechanics; it does not choose the person or authorize communication. PeTTa/MeTTa owns the distinction between selected principal and live-effect authority. JavaScript launches the finite binder and checks evidence/redaction/severed cases but cannot grant reach.
falsifiers: The selected account is inferred rather than explicitly supplied; zero or multiple candidates match; P5 private/source/candidate/transport hashes differ; the actual username, stable ID or credential appears in tracked evidence; live-effect approval becomes true; an unexecuted native expression passes; a severed hash or authority still binds; P5 private evidence is overwritten; or any network, credential, post, message, model, promotion or activation effect occurs.
scope_review: Add one fixed private principal-binding probe, typed native validation, positive/severed/neutral/restored evidence, redaction/secret checks, closure and the next separately frozen plan. Preserve P5 records. No Mattermost HTTP, Keychain, candidate/transport modification, message, model, Docker, promotion, activation, push or control edit.
rollback: Delete the ignored P6 binding record and remove the P6 probe/evidence files. P5 identity resolution, Keychain, Mattermost membership and all external state remain unchanged; no live effect exists.
